[Beat 1 · setup]
Yuha sat on the hallway bench by the shoe rack. She pulled on her left shoe with a tug. Mom had pressed a tulip into her hand, and its stem felt cool and smooth. "In you go, little tulip," Yuha whispered, and she tucked it into her pocket. Choroki poked his green head toward the pocket. Something soft and red-petaled tickled his nose!

[Beat 2 · want]
In the small garden, the morning dew was wet on Yuha's sleeves. Yuha spotted one round tomato, red as a ripe cherry. "Come on, Choroki, come with me!" she called. A ladybug sat on the stem tip and spun round and round. Yuha picked the tomato with slow, careful fingers and set it on her palm. It was warm from the sun. What would she do with it?

[Beat 3 · attempt]
One, two, three, little tomatoes went rolling, rolling! Yuha hugged three tomatoes to her chest, and her cheeks puffed with effort. She climbed the windy hill, step by step, and Choroki plodded behind her. "Almost there!" Yuha cried, looking at the top. Whoosh! The wind snatched her yellow hat, and all the tomatoes bounced down the hill. Bump, bump, bump, away they rolled!

[Beat 4 · attempt]
One, two, three, four, five, little tomatoes went rolling, rolling! Yuha gathered the tomatoes and tucked them into her shirt. She puffed and huffed up the steep stone steps. Behind her, Choroki munched a tomato, crunch, crunch, and gulped it down. Hic! His tail wiggled with every hiccup. "Choroki, you ate one!" Yuha gasped. Then her shirt tore, and plop, plop, plop, the tomatoes tumbled out!

[Beat 5 · turn]
Yuha plopped down on the play-room mat with a thump. Her arms hung limp, and her shirt was wrinkled and wet. She stared at the heap of tomatoes on the mat. Then she pulled the tulip out of her pocket. "Look, Choroki, a little flower!" she said, and she waved it high. Flutter, flutter! The garden ladybug landed on the red petals, as light as a crumb.

[Beat 6 · resolution]
The ladybug tapped one tomato, tap, tap, tap, right from the tulip. "Oh, one at a time!" Yuha said, and she tucked the tomatoes into her arms, one by one. Now it was not heavy at all. One, two, three, little tomatoes went hic and thump! Choroki sang along, "Hic, thump, hic, thump!" Yuha swayed to the beat and carried the tomatoes to her friends. Everyone nibbled and giggled.

[Beat 7 · close]
Ding-dong, ding-dong! The going-home bell rang through the hall. Yuha carried the ladybug on the tulip back to the garden. The ladybug hopped onto a green leaf and gave one small spin. Then Yuha went back to the shoe rack in the hallway. With the tulip in her empty hand, she walked home with Choroki beside her. They hummed, "Hic, hic, thump, thump," all the way home.

[Beat 1 · setup]
Sunlight fell across the living room floor. Yuha sat down and pulled on one yellow boot. "My boot is so squeaky!" she said, and she pulled it off by the blanket tunnel. Yuha crawled toward the tunnel mouth, but it was shut tight. Choroki pushed with his front paw, slide, slide, and the tunnel did not budge. Why would it not open?

[Beat 2 · want]
"Where did the tunnel key go?" Yuha asked. "Let's go together!" She took Choroki's hand and held it tight. A snail crept slowly along the sunny porch window. "The key is far away," the snail said in a slow, soft voice. Yuha tapped her chin and said, "Is it up high? Is it down low? I will ask every place!" Choroki nodded and licked his lips.

[Beat 3 · attempt]
Yuha and Choroki went behind the sofa, where the tall ladder stood. Yuha climbed up, one rung, two rungs, three rungs. Choroki climbed after her, huffing a little. At the very top, Yuha cupped her hands and shouted, "Tunnel, open!" Her words went out over the room, but nothing creaked below. Yuha looked down and said, "Is the key up on the high ladder? No, no key here!" The tunnel door opens from below, through a gap in the blanket, so shouting could not open it. What was that jingly sound?

[Beat 4 · attempt]
Next, Yuha and Choroki tiptoed to the whispering reeds beside the shoe rack. The reeds went shh, shh, whisper, whisper around their ears. Then jingle, jingle! Yuha gasped and said, "I hear the key!" Just then, a gust of wind went whoosh, and the reeds rustled louder than before. The jingle sank under the noise, and Yuha frowned and said, "Is the key in the whispering reeds? No, no key here!" Choroki sat in the grass, crunching a sweet reed berry. Where would they look now?

[Beat 5 · attempt]
Then Yuha and Choroki reached a field full of soft white fog. Yuha put one finger to her lips and whispered, "Shh!" Something round and shiny stood in the mist like a door handle. She ran to grab it, but her hand only closed on a gray fog shadow. Then Choroki found two stones that looked exactly the same. Yuha swapped them, Choroki swapped them back, and Yuha cried, "This is not the same stone as before!" Choroki puffed his cheeks and said, "It is the same stone!" Yuha sat down in the fog with a plop, and she did not say whether the key was in the foggy field.

[Beat 6 · turn]

Yuha grabbed Choroki's hand, and the two of them ran back to the living room. There stood the yellow boot by the blanket tunnel, and something inside it went twinkle. Yuha peeked in and said, "Is the key in my boot? Yes, here is the key!"

She took Choroki's hand and said, "Let's go together!" On the porch, the snail waved one feeler from the window, slow and sweet. [Beat 1 · setup]
Yuha kneels by the black stone wall at dusk. She digs in the sand and finds a shiny mirror piece. "Look, Choroki, it sparkles!" Yuha says, and she holds it up high. Then the lighthouse keeper says, "I'll go switch on the light." His boots crunch up the hill to the white lighthouse, and Yuha and Choroki wait on the sand, because the sea is only for grown-ups and children together.

[Beat 2 · want]
Yuha stomps her feet on the cool sand. Thump, thump, thump! "Why is the light so slow?" she asks. Choroki sits beside her and peels a tangerine, and the sweet smell drifts out. Choroki chews slowly and does not hurry at all. Then Yuha cups her hands and shouts, "Let's go together!" From beyond the stone wall, a voice shouts back, "Let's go together!" Yuha's eyes go wide. Somebody is over there!

[Beat 3 · attempt]
Yuha runs to the sand dune to find the voice. Her feet sink, and the sand goes *pook, pook, pook*. "Almost there, Choroki!" she calls, panting hard. She is nearly at the very top when a gull dives down with a loud *kkiluk!* Yuha jumps, her feet slip, and she slides all the way down on her bottom. She stands up and shouts, "Let's go together!" And the voice shouts back, louder this time, "Let's go together!"

[Beat 4 · attempt]
Next, Yuha crosses the grass field, and the little seeds go *chak, chak* onto her sleeves. "Yuck, they are sticking everywhere!" she says. She flicks them off and watches only her feet. Without looking up, she walks past the lighthouse and ends up at a stone wall on the far side. Choroki rubs a seedy tummy and says, "I'm hungry." Just then, a rumble rolls through the sky. *Rrrrumble!* Yuha gasps, "Thunder!" and she ducks behind the tangerine field wall. But Choroki just pats his belly, because the rumble was only his tummy!

[Beat 5 · attempt]
Yuha follows the voice to a narrow log bridge that creaks, *kkeek, kkeek*. She peers across, but nobody is there. Then the voice drifts from the sand by the string of shells. Yuha and Choroki walk past the haenyeo hut and over to the shell string, but still nobody waves. Yuha's shoulders droop, and she kicks a little pebble. Then Choroki splits a tangerine slice in half and hands her one side. The two sit side by side and do not say one word.

[Beat 6 · turn]
By the string of shells, Yuha lifts the mirror piece and shouts, "Let's go together!" Over the stone wall, the very same voice shouts back. At that moment, Yuha looks into the mirror. The girl in the glass opens her mouth just like Yuha does! Yuha blinks and blinks again. The voice was never a friend at all. It was her own echo!

[Beat 7 · resolution]
Yuha and Choroki laugh and laugh, *kkarr-kkarr*, holding their tummies. Then the lighthouse blazes bright, and warm gold light spills over the sand. The lighthouse keeper waves and walks down the hill, his boots crunching. "Mister, I found my face in the mirror, and the voice was my echo!" Yuha says. Choroki giggles and says, "Tell him about my rumble too!"

[Beat 8 · close]
The three walk home with the bright lighthouse behind them. The house smells of sweet tangerines. Yuha sets the mirror piece beside her pillow and lies down next to Choroki. She closes her eyes, and far outside the window, the lighthouse light blinks, blink, blink.

Yuha holds her breath, leans close, and blows softly, "Hooo." The puff glides over the pond, light as a feather.

회전목마 옆 개울이 졸졸 흘러요. 유하가 "향신료 구름 안에 있을까? 아니, 졸졸!" 하고 물속을 들여다봐요. 초록이가 물을 꿀꺽꿀꺽 마셔서 배가 빵빵해져요. 그래도 개울 바닥에는 조약돌만 보여요.

[비트 6 · turn]
유하가 빵집 앞 돌길에 털썩 앉아요. "초록아, 어디로 가야 할까?" 하고 물어요. 돌 틈에서 작은 달팽이가 나와요. 달팽이가 지나간 자리에 반짝이는 길이 생겨요.

[비트 7 · resolution]

[비트 8 · close]
빵집 오븐 타이머가 땡! 울려요. 유하가 베레모를 머리에 써요. "같이 가자!" 유하가 외쳐요. 두 친구는 소파 뒤 터널 속으로 들어가요. 소파 옆에서 별 스티커가 반짝반짝 빛나요.

en.rich:
[Beat 1 · setup]
Yuha steps out of the sofa tunnel into a Paris bakery lane. Warm bread smells float up from the shop door, and her nose twitches. "Wow, it smells so yummy!" Yuha cheers, and she presses a shiny star sticker onto her new beret. Then a park duck dashes up with a loud quack! The duck snatches the beret in her beak and waddles away.

[Beat 2 · want]
Yuha grabs Choroki's green hand tight. "Let's go together!" she says. Choroki holds a warm loaf, and he licks his lips. "Bread tastes best in the morning," he says with a sleepy smile. Yuha scans the cobblestones, and her feet bounce. Where could the beret be hiding?

[Beat 3 · attempt]
Is it inside the spice cloud by the café chair? Yuha dives into the cloud, and her fingers wiggle around. She almost grabs the beret's soft tip! Then Choroki's nose scrunches up. "Ah-ah-ACHOO!" he sneezes, and the beret whooshes up into the sky. In the spice cloud? No, ah-choo!

[Beat 4 · attempt]
Is it on the feather bridge over the river? Yuha steps on it, and the feathers tickle her toes. "Hee-hee-hee!" she giggles, and Choroki holds his tummy and laughs too. A bunny crunches a snowman's carrot nose with a loud crunch! The snowman stands there with no nose at all, and both friends laugh even louder. On the feather bridge? No, tickle-tickle! The duck has never even been to this bridge.

[Beat 5 · attempt]
Is it in the trickly brook by the merry-go-round? Choroki leans down, and his cheeks puff out. "Gulp, gulp, gulp!" he drinks, but the beret is not in the brook. His round tummy swells up like a big green balloon. Far away, the duck quacks one tiny quack. In the brook? No, trickle-trickle!

[Beat 6 · turn]
Yuha trudges back to the cobblestones by the bakery and plops down. Her chin drops onto her knees. Then a tiny snail creeps slowly out of a crack between the stones. Behind it, a shiny trail sparkles on the ground! At the end of the trail, a little star twinkles.

[Beat 7 · resolution]
Yuha and Choroki follow the snail past the stones. A duck nest sits beside the lane, and the beret lies inside like a fluffy blanket. "Here, you can have some crumbs," Yuha says, and she sprinkles bread crumbs for the duck. She lifts the beret out very gently. Then Choroki giggles about the spice cloud, the feather bridge, and the trickly brook, and they laugh and laugh!

[Beat 8 · close]
Ding! The bakery oven timer rings out. "Let's go together!" Yuha calls, and she runs with Choroki to the sofa tunnel. Back in the living room, Yuha sits down beside the sofa. The star sticker on her beret glitters and glows.

유하가 "같이 가자!" 하고 외쳐요. 초록이는 벌써 멀리 가 버렸어요. 유하가 모자를 만져요.
모자 위가 텅 비었어요. "어, 단추가 없네!" 하고 유하가 말해요.
탑 위에서 아기 미어캣이 고개를 쏙 내밀어요. "너, 혹시 봤니?" 하고 유하가 물어요. 유하가 노란 꽃에 코를 대고 킁킁 맡아요.
벌과 유하의 눈이 딱 마주쳐요. 유하가 "같이 가자…" 하고 벌에게 속삭여요. 막대기가 짧아서 닿지 않아요. 유하가 "끙차!"
하고 바위를 밀어요. 아기 미어캣이 바위 뒤에서 쏙 나와요. 유하가 얼른 손을 놓아요.
"쿵, 쿵, 첨벙!" 소리가 들려와요. 초록이가 바오밥 열매 껍데기를 모자에 매달고 걸어와요. "유하야, 나 왔어!"
하고 초록이가 손을 흔들어요. 유하의 눈이 점점 커져요. 유하가 모자를 벗어 봐요.
빛나는 단추가 그대로 있어요. "내 모자 위에 있었네!" 하고 유하가 깔깔 웃어요. 유하가 아기 미어캣에게 "같이 가자!"
하고 말해요. 시원한 물소리가 졸졸 퍼져요. 해가 아카시아 나무 뒤로 스르르 넘어가요.
유하가 모자를 베개 삼아 누워요. "잘 자." 하고 유하가 속삭여요. 둘은 새근새근 잠들어요.

Yuha sets her shiny button on top of her hat, and the button gleams like a tiny sun. She sits down with Choroki in the cool shade of a big baobab tree. Choroki yawns and says, "I will fetch water from the water hole." Then Choroki plods away, slow and slow, thump, thump.

[Beat 2 · want] Yuha leans on a round baobab root and wriggles her toes in the dust. The shade is cool, but it is very quiet. Yuha listens for Choroki's gurgly, hungry tummy, and she hears nothing at all. She jumps up and shouts, "Come together!" Choroki does not answer, because Choroki is already far, far away. Yuha taps her foot. When will Choroki come back?

[Beat 3 · attempt] Yuha gets bored, so she pats the top of her hat. Her hand finds only cloth. "Oh no, my button is gone!" Yuha cries, and her eyes go wide. She runs to the termite mound and pushes the tall grass apart. She sees dust and sticks, but nothing shiny at all. Then a baby meerkat pops up on top of the mound, and the meerkat stares at Yuha. Who is that?

[Beat 4 · attempt] Yuha tiptoes into the tickly grass. Swish, swish, swish, the grass sings. She sniffs a yellow flower, sniff, sniff, sniff, and a bee zooms out of it! The bee and Yuha stare at each other, blink, blink, blink. "Come together," Yuha whispers to the bee, and she slowly steps back, step by step. She walks on to the dry riverbed, where something sparkles between two stones. Yuha pokes a stick into the crack, but the stick is too short. Poke, poke, poke, and it still cannot reach the sparkle!

[Beat 5 · attempt] Yuha looks at a huge rock beside the crack. "That rock is hiding my button," she says, and she plants her feet in the dust. "Heave-ho!" Yuha pushes with all her might, and the rock slides a little. Then the baby meerkat pops out from behind the rock. The meerkat stands in front of Yuha and stares at her, like a little stop sign. "Come together," Yuha says, and the meerkat takes one little sip. Gulp! Then Yuha and Choroki giggle together.

Soon they fall asleep, with the button gleaming on the hat beside them.

[Beat 1 · setup]
Yuha stood in the living room, near the sofa. Behind it, the adventure tunnel looked dark and round. Yuha spotted a shiny compass in the toy box. She tucked it into her pocket, and it clinked softly. "Come with me, Choroki!" Yuha called. Choroki chewed a snack cookie and crunched along behind her. What waited at the end of the tunnel?

[Beat 2 · want]
Yuha crawled out of the tunnel into a village full of tile roofs and mud walls. She stood in a yard of a big tile-roofed house. A grown-up handed her a kite, and Yuha took it with two hands. "I will fly it very high!" Yuha said, and her red string stretched tight. Whooosh! A strong wind snapped the string, and the kite sailed away. "Come with me, Choroki!" Yuha shouted, and she ran out the gate.

[Beat 3 · attempt]
Snip-snap, snip-snap! A candy seller's scissors clinked near the market. Yuha chased the kite up a long, long hill, puffing hard. "A hill can't stop us, we will go past it!" she said, huffing and puffing. Choroki trotted behind her with crumbs on his chin. Yuha could see the top at last. Then a big ox flopped down in the middle of the road, and it would not move! The kite flew on, farther away.

[Beat 4 · attempt]
Yuha and Choroki hurried past the village well and into the woods. Swish! A low branch swung right over their heads. "A branch can't stop us, we will go past it!" Yuha said, and she ducked low. Choroki ducked too, and his ears flopped down. "The kite is stuck at the school yard!" Yuha cried, and she dashed away. She looked all around the school yard, but she found no kite. Only the sound of children reading aloud drifted over the wall.

[Beat 5 · attempt]
Next to the village pavilion, Yuha pushed into a thick bush. Splat! A sticky spider web stuck to her face. "A web can't stop us, we will go past it!" Yuha said, wiping her cheeks. A kite string hung in the web, and she yanked it with both hands. The string only tangled up more, and Yuha's arms went limp. She sat down on the ground with a thump. Clink! The compass rolled out of her pocket onto the grass.

[Beat 6 · turn]
Yuha picked up the compass and looked at the needle. It pointed back along the road she had come. "Why is it pointing that way?" Yuha asked, and she turned around. She stood on her tiptoes to see farther. Choroki rose on his tiptoes too, and the ox rose on its tiptoes, and the candy seller rose on his tiptoes. Then Yuha spotted the kite, snagged on the roof's edge of the very first yard!

[Beat 7 · resolution]
Yuha hugged the kite close with both hands and ran back the way she had come. "We got past the web, so let's go!" Yuha called, and the ox stood up and stepped aside. She zipped past the web, past the low branch, and down the long hill. Choroki puffed along behind her. Back in the yard, Yuha tied on a new string. Whoosh! The kite climbed up, up, up into the sky.

[Beat 8 · close]
The reading voices at the school yard grew quiet. Yuha and Choroki crawled back through the tunnel behind the sofa. Soon Yuha lay under her blanket in bed. She set the compass down gently beside her pillow. "Good night, Choroki," Yuha whispered, and she closed her eyes.

[Beat 2 · want]
The tunnel ended at a castle with a drawbridge, a tall tower, and a flapping flag. A kind knight beat his drum, boom, boom, boom. "A pigeon waits at the top with a letter," he said. Yuha rubbed her gold button, and she planned to go all the way up. What was waiting for them on the way?

[Beat 3 · attempt]
Beside the stable, the muddy path was thick and gooey. "I can't go over the mud, so I will go through it!" Yuha called. Yuha and Choroki squelched along, splish, splash, splosh. They pushed through a wide door they thought led onward, but it opened into a stall full of hay. Out of the hay popped a baby bear, rubbing his sleepy eyes!

[Beat 4 · attempt]
Beyond the well in the courtyard, a stream bubbled along. "I can't go over the stream, so I will go through it!" Yuha called. She laid stepping stones down one by one, and she was almost across. Then the wind went whoosh, and her hat rolled away, round and round. Yuha chased it, missed her stone, and splash! Cold water soaked her shoe.

[Beat 5 · attempt]
Past the big pot in the kitchen, the path was narrow. A log came rolling, rumble, rumble, and it blocked the way. "I can't go over the log, so I will go through it!" Yuha cried. At the top of the tower, a huge winged shadow flapped on the wall. Flap, flap, flap! Yuha froze with her mouth open. en.rich:
[Beat 1 · setup]
Yuha stood by the sofa tunnel. She put on her helmet and clipped the radio to her belt. "Today we walk with the robot dog!" she said. Then she tucked a dry mud brick into her pocket, and the brick felt rough and warm.

[Beat 2 · want]
Yuha and Choroki crawled through the tunnel and reached the Mars base. The robot dog was not waiting at the dome door. Round little pawprints dotted the sandy floor of the greenhouse. "Come with me, Choroki!" Yuha said. She held his hand, and the two of them followed the prints between the tomato plants. Where would the prints go?

[Beat 3 · attempt]
The pawprints stopped at a huge rock on the red sand hill. Yuha pushed with both hands. Choroki pushed with his shoulder. "Heave-ho, heave-ho!" they puffed. The rock did not move at all. "A rock is too big to push, so we go around it!" Yuha said. Then Choroki slipped into a thin crack beside the rock, and Yuha squeezed in after him.

[Beat 4 · attempt]
Whoosh! The sand wind blew across the windy hill. Yuha and Choroki climbed up, almost to the top. Then a big gust shook Yuha's helmet, and they tumbled down, bump, bump, bump. "Wind is too strong to stand in, so we crawl through it!" Yuha said. She lay flat on the sand and crawled up, step by step. Far away, a faint "woof, woof" drifted over the hill.

[Beat 5 · attempt]
A rainbow cloud of spices floated over the hill. It smelled sweet and sharp, and Yuha's nose tickled. "Ah-choo! Ah-choo!" Choroki sneezed, too. They followed the woofing sound, but they found only an empty rover seat. "A cloud is too puffy to catch, so we float through it!" Yuha said in a tired little voice. She sat down, took the mud brick out of her pocket, and rubbed it. Then she used it as a seat.

[Beat 6 · turn]
Yuha put her hands on the mud brick. For fun, she kicked up into a handstand. The whole world turned upside down. In the pink rock valley, a robot dog was peeking out of a crack! He wagged his tail beside a pile of mud bricks. "I see you!" Yuha cried. The robot dog had been hiding all along, ready to surprise her.

[Beat 7 · resolution]
"Woof, woof!" Yuha barked back at him. From the dome greenhouse came a loud "Meeeh!" A goat was answering her! Yuha, Choroki, and the robot dog all laughed. Then they hurried home past the spice cloud, the windy hill, and the big rock, all upside down. "Now we go through together!" they sang.

[Beat 8 · close]
The radio crackled, and Mom's voice came out of it. Yuha crawled back through the tunnel. Then she lay under her warm blanket at home. She set the mud brick gently beside her bed. A tiny grain of sand sparkled on top of it.
